# the paths that run .github/workflows/semver-checks.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow must list the same patterns in the same order
# (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file a job of the workflow executes or reads is listed: a missing one skips the
# check on a change that alters it
# the public API and the version the step is measured to
src/**
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
# cargo semver-checks runs at the repository root, where this file picks the toolchain

# the gate, its tests and the consumer feature sets
scripts/semver_gate.py
scripts/test_semver_gate.py
.github/semver-gate.toml
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/semver-checks.yml
.github/paths/semver-checks.txt
